bot.pairIntro: This bot is used to pair AI Agent Notifier. Open the extension popup → "Phone" → "Pair via the bot".
bot.codeNotFound: That code was not found or has expired. Go back to the extension settings and start pairing again.
bot.capReached: The shared bot is paused right now — too many connections for the beta. Try again later, or switch to the "your own bot" mode in the extension settings.
bot.paired: ✅ Paired! You can go back to the extension settings.
bot.help: I can do two things: pair the extension (the "Pair via the bot" button in its settings) and take feedback — send /feedback followed by your message.
bot.feedbackUsage:
Send your suggestion or describe the problem in one command, for example:
/feedback notifications stop arriving after a reboot
bot.feedbackTooMany: Too many messages in a row — please try again later.
bot.feedbackSaveFailed: Could not save your message. Please try again later.
bot.feedbackThanks: ✅ Thanks, passed it on. If anything needs clarifying, I'll write here.
